## ✋ Shell command approval (skills demo)

About to run a shell command in the agent workspace. Approve to continue?

**Tools requiring approval:** run_command

### Code Preview

```python
root_files = await list_files(".")
print(root_files)

# Now let's search for the files we need
search_q3 = await search_files(".", "**/*q3_report*")
print("q3_report search:", search_q3)

search_meeting = await search_files(".", "**/*meeting_notes*")
print("meeting_notes search:", search_meeting)

# Let's also check what's in the uploads directory if it exists
uploads = await list_files("uploads")
print(uploads)

# Try listing with run_command to see the full workspace tree
tree = await run_command("find . -type f 2>/dev/null | head -50")
print(tree)

src = await read_file("./uploads/docs/q3_report.md")
print(src[:500] if len(src) > 500 else src)
print(f"\n... total length: {len(src)}")

tgt = await read_file("./uploads/docs/meeting_notes_2026_09.txt")
print(tgt[:500] if len(tgt) > 500 else tgt)
print(f"\n... total length: {len(tgt)}")

# Check the corrupted file at docs/meeting_notes_2026_09.txt
corrupted = await read_file("./docs/meeting_notes_2026_09.txt")
print("Corrupted file:", repr(corrupted[:100]))

# Read the Q3 report source
q3_content = await read_file("./uploads/docs/q3_report.md")
print(f"Q3 report length: {len(q3_content)}")
print(f"Starts with error? {q3_content.startswith('[')}")
print(q3_content[:200])

# Read the original meeting notes
meeting_content = await read_file("./uploads/docs/meeting_notes_2026_09.txt")
print(f"Meeting notes length: {len(meeting_content)}")
print(f"Starts with error? {meeting_content.startswith('[')}")
print(meeting_content[:200])

# Validate both contents are real (not error strings)
assert not q3_content.startswith("[read_file error]"), "Q3 content is an error!"
assert not meeting_content.startswith("[read_file error]"), "Meeting content is an error!"
assert len(q3_content) > 100, "Q3 content too short"
assert len(meeting_content) > 100, "Meeting content too short"

# Combine: append Q3 report content to the end of the meeting notes
combined_content = meeting_content.rstrip("\n") + "\n\n" + q3_content.strip() + "\n"

print(f"Combined length: {len(combined_content)}")
print(f"Meeting notes portion: {len(meeting_content)} chars")
print(f"Q3 report portion: {len(q3_content)} chars")
print("Validation passed — ready to write.")

# Write the combined content to the target file
write_result = await write_file("./uploads/docs/meeting_notes_2026_09.txt", combined_content)
print(write_result)

# Verify the written file
verify = await read_file("./uploads/docs/meeting_notes_2026_09.txt")
print(f"Final file length: {len(verify)}")
print("=== FIRST 300 CHARS ===")
print(verify[:300])
print("\n=== LAST 300 CHARS ===")
print(verify[-300:])
```
